spans.s: द्वंद (I) m. A plate on which the hours are struck.
द्वंद (II) n. A pair, a couple.

द्वंद्व (I) n. 1. A pair, a couple; 2. a couple of animals (including men also, K.S.vii.66) of different sexes, i.e. male and female, K.S.iii.35, Megh.i.40; 3. a couple of opposite qualities, (e.g. शीत and उष्ण, or सुख and दुःख), उपैति न द्वंद्वदुःखमिह किंचिदकिंचनोऽपि Sis.iv.64 (द्वंद्वदुःखं शीतोष्णदुःखम् Mall.); 4. strife, contention, quarrel; 5. duel; 6. doubt, uncertainty; 7. a stronghold, a fortress; 8. a secret.

द्वंद्व (II) m. One of the four compounds in which two or more words are joined together, which, if standing by themselves, would be in the same case and connected by the conjunction ‘and,’ द्वंद्वो द्विगुरपि चाहम् Ud., द्वंद्वः सामासिकस्य च Bg.x.33.
द्वंद्व-चर, -चारिन् m. the ruddy goose, दयिता द्वंद्वचरं पतत्रिणम् R.viii.56, xvi.63.
द्वंद्व-चर, -चारिन् m. the ruddy goose, दयिता द्वंद्वचरं पतत्रिणम् R.viii.56, xvi.63.
द्वंद्व-भाव m. antagoism, discord.
द्वंद्व-मोह m. trouble excited by doubt.
द्वंद्व-युद्ध n. a duel, a single combat.
द्वंद्व-शस् ind. two by two, in pairs.
द्वय (I) a. (f. यी) Two-fold, double, of two kinds, मालतीकुसुमस्येव द्वयी वृत्तिः (v.l. for द्वे गती ह) मनस्विनः Bhartr.ii.104. (The word may be used in the plural also. See Sis.iii.57).
द्वय (II) n. 1. A pair, a couple, R.i.19, iv.4, iii.8; 2. two-fold nature, untruthfulness.
